core_idea: LCE E.G.O::Dimension Shredder Yi Sang is a Damage Dealer — **Charge** cycle — build Count toward **20**, spend on highest-damage skills (often **Rip Space**), then rebuild for the next window. Scaling conditions: Final Power +1 per 6 (Rupture + Dimensional Rift) (max +3); At 3+ Charge Potency, Coin Power +1.
playstyle_guide:
- Ramp **Charge Count** toward **20** before committing **Rip Space** — **S1 — Dimensional Slice** adds **+6 Charge Count** per **On Hit** coin; **S2 — Consecutive Dimensional Slice** adds **+6 Charge Count** per **On Hit** coin.
- **Haste** raises Speed for next turn — several bonuses here require being faster than the target.
- Reach scaling conditions before committing S3: Final Power +1 per 6 (Rupture + Dimensional Rift) (max +3).
- Hold S3 for when At 15+ Charge Count is met — that condition is what unlocks its full damage ceiling.

**S1 — Dimensional Slice** (BP 6, CP +7, 1 coin): rolls — low 6, high 13 (Extremely High).
- Final Power +1 for every 6 (Charge Count on self + Rupture and Dimensional Rift on target) (max 3); [On Use] Consume 2 Charge Count to gain Coin Power +1
- Gain +6 Charge Count (once per Skill); [On Hit] Inflict 2 Rupture; [On Hit] Consume 1 Dimensional Castaway to Reuse this Coin (once per Skill)

**S2 — Consecutive Dimensional Slice** (BP 4, CP +6, 2 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average / Slightly High stacked).
- Final Power +1 per 6 (Rupture + Dimensional Rift) (max +3)
- Needs 3+ Charge Potency to activate — prioritise building stacks before using.
- Gain +6 Charge Count; [On Hit] Inflict 1 Rupture
- Inflict 2 Rupture; [On Hit] Inflict 1 Dimensional Rift; [On Hit] Deal Slash damage equal to (Charge Potency on self x 4)% of this Coin's final damage (max 20%)

**S3 — Rip Space** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average).
- **Coin Power** scales with **Charge** (+1 per 7, max +2) — build stacks first.
- Final Power +1 per 6 (Rupture + Dimensional Rift) (max +4)
- Gain +1 Charge Count; [On Hit] Inflict 1 Rupture
- Inflict 1 Rupture; [On Hit] Inflict 2 Dimensional Rift; [On Hit] Deal Slash damage equal to (Charge Potency on self x 4)% of this Coin's final damage (max 20%)

*↳ Alternate S3 — Four-dimensional Refraction Time Series Severance* (BP 5, CP +3): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average).
  - Gain 1 Quadricolor Dimensions

Combat passive — **Open Alley**: Gain 1 Charge Potency every time this unit consumes 10 cumulative Charge Count in this Encounter.
  - When another ally's Skill hits an enemy: At Attack End, consume 1 Dimensional Castaway to activate "Dimensional Slice" against the said t….
  - then, gain 1 Quadricolor Dimensions.

Combat passive — **VelocityAndCoordinatesAndVelocity**: If this unit's Speed is faster than the target's, deal +(Speed difference x Charge Potency on self)% damage (max 20%).
  - Turn End: Gain (Charge Potency on self / 2) Haste next turn (max 2.
  - rounded down).

Defense skill — **Counter: Sidestep**: [Combat Start] Gain Charge Barrier equal to Charge Potency on self (once per turn.
  - [Combat Start] Gain 1 Dimensional Castaway and 1 Quadricolor Dimensions (once per turn).
  - At 3+ Charge Potency, gain 1 additional Stack of the above effects.
  - [Combat Start] At fewer than 7 Charge Count, consume (7 - Charge Count on self)% HP to gain up to 7 Charge Count (this unit's HP cannot drop to 0 d….
